subject: Lighthouse POC outcomes — short blurb + permission to publish
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Keene <akeene@lighthouse-retail.com>, Samira Ortiz <samira.ortiz@lighthouse-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-02-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Lighthouse POC outcomes — short blurb + permission to publish

Hi Alex and Samira,

Thanks again for running the pilot with us last month — really enjoyed working with your ops team. I pulled together the high-level outcomes from the 6-week POC and wanted to share a concise snapshot for your review. If you're comfortable, we'd love a 1–2 line quote we can use in a short case highlight and a quick 10–15 minute call to get sign-off and record a 30s audio snippet (optional).

POC highlights (production-like workload mixed search + cart intents):
- Average per-request latency down from ~420ms to ~120ms (71% reduction)
- Cost per 1k tokens reduced ~58% due to batching + prefix caching
- Throughput: sustained 650 req/min during peak replays vs baseline 210 req/min
- Error rate (timeout/503) dropped from 0.9% → 0.1%
- Pilot window: Jan 4 — Feb 2 (6 weeks)

Attachments: lighthouse-poc-kpis.csv (end-to-end traces + cost calc), latency-heatmap.png (peak hourly latency distribution).

Proposed one-line blurb for review: "Using Redwood Inference, Lighthouse cut inference latency 71% and lowered per-request costs by more than half, enabling higher throughput during peak shopping windows." Happy to edit if you'd prefer different wording/attribution.

If you're fine with a short blurb, we can:
1) Publish the one-liner with Lighthouse (company name, logo, non-sensitive metrics).
2) Optionally schedule a 10–15 minute sync this week to capture a short quote and record a 30s audio clip for social.

Suggested times (PST): Wed 02/09 10:00–10:30, Thu 02/10 14:00–14:30. If none work, tell me a window that does.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0147

From: Alex Keene <akeene@lighthouse-retail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Ortiz <samira.ortiz@lighthouse-retail.com>
Date: 2028-02-08T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse POC outcomes — short blurb + permission to publish

Thanks Tessa — great summary and congrats to both teams on the smooth run. Numbers look right from our side; ops ran the replay set you provided and we validated the latency/cost calc against our telemetry.

We're ok with the proposed blurb with two small edits: replace "more than half" with "~58%" and change "during peak shopping windows" to "during peak checkout flows." So final: "Using Redwood Inference, Lighthouse cut inference latency 71% and lowered per-request costs ~58%, enabling higher throughput during peak checkout flows."

We can do Thu 02/10 14:00–14:15 PST for a quick sign-off call. Samira will join and she can give a 1–2 line quote on behalf of Ops. Legal will want to see the final blurb before publication — copying our internal marketing contact is not necessary yet, but we will loop them if we proceed to a published case study.

Also — we do prefer stats without customer PII or sample payloads. The attachments you sent are fine as long as any cart ids are redacted.

Alex
VP Product, Lighthouse Retail
akeene@lighthouse-retail.com
